note: Every publish.sh gate, its class and why (rule of Adriaan Mol, 20 Oct 2026). BLOCKING: the data is incomplete, mixed or from more than one pull; a published figure is wrong or cannot be traced; the Asana gate; a generator or the page fails to build - the edition is not published. REVIEW: everything else - the edition is published, each failure is shown PROVISIONAL on the page and listed on that week's approval task for Jan or Adriaan. publish.sh runs every gate to the end and decides from this file; a gate missing from it counts as BLOCKING. Layout-type gates (rerun_once) that fail are run once more on the same built page and the second result counts. Moving a gate between classes is the only change this file makes: no threshold or logic changed.

verify_reuse.why: the extracts on disk are not exactly the kept set the run says it reused: mixed data

form_snapshot.why: the form snapshot the page's form claims rest on could not be built

generator.why: a generated region of the page failed to build (one entry per generator, generator:<path>)

asana_push_owners.why: part of the Asana gate: owners could not be pushed to Asana

asana.why: the Asana gate: an open action without exactly one task, owner or deadline differs, or closed without evidence

status_actions.why: a non-complete status names no open action: a cross-reference on the page, not a figure

change_review.why: the change review region and the approval task could not be built

calendar_check.why: the calendar checklist answers could not be copied into the page's sources

prerender_write.why: the figures could not be written into the static HTML: the page did not build

render_check.why: rendered layout differs from the recorded manifest (headings, tables, tile heights): presentation

static_figures.why: a static figure differs from what the page computes: a published figure is wrong

readability.why: a table breaks the formatting and readability rule: presentation

layout.why: the layout acceptance test (widths, open details) failed: presentation

provenance.why: a provenance panel does not match its figure: a published figure cannot be traced

panels.why: a figure panel or expanding block overlaps or is clipped: presentation

transcription_page.why: the transcription tool page fails its browser test: a working page, not a published figure

routes_page.why: the route page's CSV or print export fails its browser test: a working page, not a published figure

migration.why: a response on a known successor form that no population reads: listed for a person to route

links.why: a link to an mWater portal route that does not exist: navigation, not a figure

figure_census.why: the figure census (every rendered number has a source) - named REVIEW in the rule

prose_figures.why: a figure typed into the prose: a published figure that cannot be traced (a figure gate)

empty_figures.why: a figure renders empty without JavaScript: the page did not build its static figures

vintage_pull.why: an extract missing, failed, older than the run, or from another pull: incomplete or mixed data

vintage_shrink.why: an extract has fewer rows than at the last passing build and no recorded acceptance: listed for a person to accept

wpopmeta.why: a WPOPMETA field disagrees with the allocation run that produced it: a published figure is wrong

change_review_check.why: a repository move without a decision, or an approval not by Adriaan or Jan: a figure moved untraced

generators.why: an embedded field has no generator, or its generator disagrees: a figure that cannot be traced

routes_plans.why: the catch-up route plans are not this build's or miss an overdue pump: a working plan, not a published figure

paging.why: an extract carries a repeated _id (the paging fault): incomplete or mixed data

piped_pairing.why: the piped water-quality pairing could not be computed: a generator failed

moramanga_parent.why: the Moramanga duplicate-parent readout could not run: a readout, never a figure

distances.why: a distance stated in the corrections log no longer reproduces: a published figure is wrong

consistency.why: the consistency checker failed or could not run: published figures disagree with each other or their sources
